units.rawText: Helix sleeps very well tonight.
units.displayText: Helix sleeps very well tonight.

spans.text: Helix sleeps very well tonight.

units.rawText: The sunlight shines through the window and onto her face, rousing her "biological clock". As she opens her eyes, Helix is briefly stunned. She is no longer in the lab; she has returned to her dorm room at some point.

units.rawText: Rise and shine. I hope you slept well, Helix-sama.
units.displayText: Rise and shine. I hope you slept well, Helix-sama.

spans.text: Rise and shine. I hope you slept well, Helix-sama.

units.rawText: The shrine maiden before her narrows her eyes and smiles. Helix remembers this Doll. She could sense her reserve when the Professor first brought her back, but she seems much cheerier now.
units.displayText: The shrine maiden before her narrows her eyes and smiles. Helix remembers this Doll. She could sense her reserve when the Professor first brought her back, but she seems much cheerier now.

units.rawText: Ki... Kimi...
units.displayText: Ki... Kimi...

spans.text: Ki... Kimi...

units.rawText: Please call me Kimie, Helix-sama.
units.displayText: Please call me Kimie, Helix-sama.

spans.text: Please call me Kimie, Helix-sama.

units.rawText: Ah, you're awake at last, Helix-chan. Any later and your breakfast would have gone cold.
units.displayText: Ah, you're awake at last, Helix-chan. Any later and your breakfast would have gone cold.

spans.text: Ah, you're awake at last, Helix-chan. Any later and your breakfast would have gone cold.

units.rawText: Her dorm table is packed with all kinds of Japanese food, ranging from bentos, sushi, and ochazuke... There are over 10 different types of snacks alone.
units.displayText: Her dorm table is packed with all kinds of Japanese food, ranging from bentos, sushi, and ochazuke... There are over 10 different types of snacks alone.

units.rawText: This is breakfast?
units.displayText: This is breakfast?

spans.text: This is breakfast?

units.rawText: I didn't know what you cared to have, so this Kimie could only make some normal dishes.
units.displayText: I didn't know what you cared to have, so this Kimie could only make some normal dishes.

spans.text: I didn't know what you cared to have, so this Kimie could only make some normal dishes.

units.rawText: Please do not worry too much if they suit your appetite, Helix-sama.
units.displayText: Please do not worry too much if they suit your appetite, Helix-sama.

spans.text: Please do not worry too much if they suit your appetite, Helix-sama.

units.rawText: You also need to balance your nutrient intake, Helix-chan~
units.displayText: You also need to balance your nutrient intake, Helix-chan~

spans.text: You also need to balance your nutrient intake, Helix-chan~

units.rawText: Ah... So you and Kimie... you all made this food for me?
units.displayText: Ah... So you and Kimie... you all made this food for me?

spans.text: Ah... So you and Kimie... you all made this food for me?

units.rawText: I heard you had not been eating well for quite some time, Helix-sama. Perhaps a meal like this would help restore your vitality.
units.displayText: I heard you had not been eating well for quite some time, Helix-sama. Perhaps a meal like this would help restore your vitality.

spans.text: I heard you had not been eating well for quite some time, Helix-sama. Perhaps a meal like this would help restore your vitality.

units.rawText: Kimie's words make the corners of Helix's eyes moisten up. She exhales heavily and blinks back the tears in her eyes, then selects a plum onigiri from the cornucopia of food before her.
units.displayText: Kimie's words make the corners of Helix's eyes moisten up. She exhales heavily and blinks back the tears in her eyes, then selects a plum onigiri from the cornucopia of food before her.

spans.text: Kimie's words make the corners of Helix's eyes moisten up. She exhales heavily and blinks back the tears in her eyes, then selects a plum onigiri from the cornucopia of food before her.

units.rawText: Wow... This is delicious!
units.displayText: Wow... This is delicious!

spans.text: Wow... This is delicious!

units.rawText: The rice is sweet and soft, and the dried plums are so refreshing...
units.displayText: The rice is sweet and soft, and the dried plums are so refreshing...

spans.text: The rice is sweet and soft, and the dried plums are so refreshing...

units.rawText: Ah~ Why does your food taste so good, Kimie? I won't be able to stop at this rate.
units.displayText: Ah~ Why does your food taste so good, Kimie? I won't be able to stop at this rate.

spans.text: Ah~ Why does your food taste so good, Kimie? I won't be able to stop at this rate.

units.rawText: Please, go ahead.
units.displayText: Please, go ahead.

spans.text: Please, go ahead.

units.rawText: Helix's hunger has long since triumphed over any reserve she might have had. Helix has a roll of sushi in her left hand and a cube of yokan in her right, while her mouth keeps chewing and chewing.
units.displayText: Helix's hunger has long since triumphed over any reserve she might have had. Helix has a roll of sushi in her left hand and a cube of yokan in her right, while her mouth keeps chewing and chewing.

spans.text: Helix's hunger has long since triumphed over any reserve she might have had. Helix has a roll of sushi in her left hand and a cube of yokan in her right, while her mouth keeps chewing and chewing.

units.rawText: Mfff... If you hadn't reminded me, Helix would have forgotten I hadn't eaten for several days.
units.displayText: Mfff... If you hadn't reminded me, Helix would have forgotten I hadn't eaten for several days.

spans.text: Mfff... If you hadn't reminded me, Helix would have forgotten I hadn't eaten for several days.

units.rawText: Well, you had 15% of your operands left. It's amazing that you could perform complicated gene compilation procedures under those conditions, Helix-chan.
units.displayText: Well, you had 15% of your operands left. It's amazing that you could perform complicated gene compilation procedures under those conditions, Helix-chan.

spans.text: Well, you had 15% of your operands left. It's amazing that you could perform complicated gene compilation procedures under those conditions, Helix-chan.

units.rawText: Do you remember what happened last night, Helix-chan?
units.displayText: Do you remember what happened last night, Helix-chan?

spans.text: Do you remember what happened last night, Helix-chan?

units.rawText: Helix shakes her head.
units.displayText: Helix shakes her head.

spans.text: Helix shakes her head.

units.rawText: I only remember doing experiments in the lab, and then I forgot everything else.
units.displayText: I only remember doing experiments in the lab, and then I forgot everything else.

spans.text: I only remember doing experiments in the lab, and then I forgot everything else.

units.rawText: Huh? You don't remember anything at all?
units.displayText: Huh? You don't remember anything at all?

spans.text: Huh? You don't remember anything at all?

units.rawText: For example... Going somewhere to eat chocolate? Lots and lots of chocolate?
units.displayText: For example... Going somewhere to eat chocolate? Lots and lots of chocolate?

spans.text: For example... Going somewhere to eat chocolate? Lots and lots of chocolate?

units.rawText: Um... I don't remember.
units.displayText: Um... I don't remember.

spans.text: Um... I don't remember.

units.rawText: Helix-sama, you had not eaten for many days, and in your sleep, your body was no longer under control and entered the Chocolaterie.
units.displayText: Helix-sama, you had not eaten for many days, and in your sleep, your body was no longer under control and entered the Chocolaterie.

spans.text: Helix-sama, you had not eaten for many days, and in your sleep, your body was no longer under control and entered the Chocolaterie.

units.rawText: Ehhhhhh??? Then, did I do anything that hurt everyone?
units.displayText: Ehhhhhh??? Then, did I do anything that hurt everyone?

spans.text: Ehhhhhh??? Then, did I do anything that hurt everyone?

units.rawText: Hehe, not at all. You just ate some failed chocolates. Don't worry about it, Helix-chan.
units.displayText: Hehe, not at all. You just ate some failed chocolates. Don't worry about it, Helix-chan.

spans.text: Hehe, not at all. You just ate some failed chocolates. Don't worry about it, Helix-chan.

units.rawText: After your neural cloud entered sleep mode, your body followed its instincts and searched for high-energy food... At least, that seems to be the logic your system was using, Helix-sama.
units.displayText: After your neural cloud entered sleep mode, your body followed its instincts and searched for high-energy food... At least, that seems to be the logic your system was using, Helix-sama.

spans.text: After your neural cloud entered sleep mode, your body followed its instincts and searched for high-energy food... At least, that seems to be the logic your system was using, Helix-sama.

units.rawText: Ah, I remember now. Before this, in the real world, Helix often operated in low-power mode.
units.displayText: Ah, I remember now. Before this, in the real world, Helix often operated in low-power mode.

spans.text: Ah, I remember now. Before this, in the real world, Helix often operated in low-power mode.

units.rawText: In order to prevent me from consuming too much energy, Helix had an override protection system installed... (whimper) So that's how it worked!
units.displayText: In order to prevent me from consuming too much energy, Helix had an override protection system installed... (whimper) So that's how it worked!

spans.text: In order to prevent me from consuming too much energy, Helix had an override protection system installed... (whimper) So that's how it worked!

units.rawText: I can't believe I actually went sleepwalking... This is so embarrassing...
units.displayText: I can't believe I actually went sleepwalking... This is so embarrassing...

spans.text: I can't believe I actually went sleepwalking... This is so embarrassing...

units.rawText: There is no need to feel ashamed of this, Helix-sama. But you must take good care of yourself.
units.displayText: There is no need to feel ashamed of this, Helix-sama. But you must take good care of yourself.

spans.text: There is no need to feel ashamed of this, Helix-sama. But you must take good care of yourself.

units.rawText: Take care of myself... (winces)
units.displayText: Take care of myself... (winces)

spans.text: Take care of myself... (winces)

units.rawText: I may not be able to keep you company any further, Helix... So please, take good care of yourself.
units.displayText: I may not be able to keep you company any further, Helix... So please, take good care of yourself.

spans.text: I may not be able to keep you company any further, Helix... So please, take good care of yourself.

units.rawText: The bitterness rising in her heart causes Helix to put down the yokan she's holding. She stares at her plate for a long time without saying a word.
units.displayText: The bitterness rising in her heart causes Helix to put down the yokan she's holding. She stares at her plate for a long time without saying a word.

spans.text: The bitterness rising in her heart causes Helix to put down the yokan she's holding. She stares at her plate for a long time without saying a word.

units.rawText: Helix-sama...
units.displayText: Helix-sama...

spans.text: Helix-sama...

units.rawText: Mm, I'm fine, Kimie. I just remembered some things...
units.displayText: Mm, I'm fine, Kimie. I just remembered some things...

spans.text: Mm, I'm fine, Kimie. I just remembered some things...

units.rawText: Was it from the real world?
units.displayText: Was it from the real world?

spans.text: Was it from the real world?

units.rawText: Yeah. In the past, when Helix was in the real world, all I had to do was complete my research in the lab and focus all my efforts on challenging the genetic problems of the world.
units.displayText: Yeah. In the past, when Helix was in the real world, all I had to do was complete my research in the lab and focus all my efforts on challenging the genetic problems of the world.

spans.text: Yeah. In the past, when Helix was in the real world, all I had to do was complete my research in the lab and focus all my efforts on challenging the genetic problems of the world.

units.rawText: Helix was a Doll, so eating and drinking wasn't an issue. I let the researchers handle my body maintenance, neural expansion, system installations, and so on.
units.displayText: Helix was a Doll, so eating and drinking wasn't an issue. I let the researchers handle my body maintenance, neural expansion, system installations, and so on.

spans.text: Helix was a Doll, so eating and drinking wasn't an issue. I let the researchers handle my body maintenance, neural expansion, system installations, and so on.

units.rawText: But now in the Oasis, there are no researchers to take care of me. Helix doesn't know what she can do for the Oasis. She can't even take care of herself.
units.displayText: But now in the Oasis, there are no researchers to take care of me. Helix doesn't know what she can do for the Oasis. She can't even take care of herself.

spans.text: But now in the Oasis, there are no researchers to take care of me. Helix doesn't know what she can do for the Oasis. She can't even take care of herself.

units.rawText: No man is an island, as they say. You do not need to worry about being perfect in every respect, Helix-sama.
units.displayText: No man is an island, as they say. You do not need to worry about being perfect in every respect, Helix-sama.

spans.text: No man is an island, as they say. You do not need to worry about being perfect in every respect, Helix-sama.

units.rawText: I like the Oasis, and I like everyone. But I also miss the real world...
units.displayText: I like the Oasis, and I like everyone. But I also miss the real world...

spans.text: I like the Oasis, and I like everyone. But I also miss the real world...

units.rawText: Helix misses the real world, and she misses how she could give all her strength to everyone without holding back (sniffle)...
units.displayText: Helix misses the real world, and she misses how she could give all her strength to everyone without holding back (sniffle)...

spans.text: Helix misses the real world, and she misses how she could give all her strength to everyone without holding back (sniffle)...

units.rawText: Helix is so useless. Even though she's in the Oasis, and she has the Professor and her friends, she's still so weak... (sob)
units.displayText: Helix is so useless. Even though she's in the Oasis, and she has the Professor and her friends, she's still so weak... (sob)

units.rawText: Kimie gently embraces Helix.
units.displayText: Kimie gently embraces Helix.

spans.text: Kimie gently embraces Helix.

units.rawText: This Kimie understands how you feel, Helix-sama.
units.displayText: This Kimie understands how you feel, Helix-sama.

spans.text: This Kimie understands how you feel, Helix-sama.

units.rawText: The days can be lonely, and I am not the only bird who feels like they have no nest.
units.displayText: The days can be lonely, and I am not the only bird who feels like they have no nest.

spans.text: The days can be lonely, and I am not the only bird who feels like they have no nest.

units.rawText: (Sob) Do you miss your friends in the real world too, Kimie?
units.displayText: (Sob) Do you miss your friends in the real world too, Kimie?

spans.text: (Sob) Do you miss your friends in the real world too, Kimie?

units.rawText: This Kimie stayed within a shrine and rarely had contact with others. But one person was with me from the moment of my birth: a senior shrine maiden called Kaede-sama, whom I constantly accompanied.
units.displayText: This Kimie stayed within a shrine and rarely had contact with others. But one person was with me from the moment of my birth: a senior shrine maiden called Kaede-sama, whom I constantly accompanied.

spans.text: This Kimie stayed within a shrine and rarely had contact with others. But one person was with me from the moment of my birth: a senior shrine maiden called Kaede-sama, whom I constantly accompanied.

units.rawText: In this day and age, old traditions that are hundreds, if not thousands of years old face the danger of having no inheritors and fading into obscurity. On top of that, the many years of war have caused the profession of "miko" to slowly slip from the public's eye.
units.displayText: In this day and age, old traditions that are hundreds, if not thousands of years old face the danger of having no inheritors and fading into obscurity. On top of that, the many years of war have caused the profession of "miko" to slowly slip from the public's eye.

spans.text: In this day and age, old traditions that are hundreds, if not thousands of years old face the danger of having no inheritors and fading into obscurity. On top of that, the many years of war have caused the profession of "miko" to slowly slip from the public's eye.

units.rawText: Kaede-sama was old and full of years and had never had any children. There was nobody around her who was willing to inherit Kurenoyume Shrine from her and precious few people who were willing to take the time to learn the rites to propitiate the kami.
units.displayText: Kaede-sama was old and full of years and had never had any children. There was nobody around her who was willing to inherit Kurenoyume Shrine from her and precious few people who were willing to take the time to learn the rites to propitiate the kami.

spans.text: Kaede-sama was old and full of years and had never had any children. There was nobody around her who was willing to inherit Kurenoyume Shrine from her and precious few people who were willing to take the time to learn the rites to propitiate the kami.

units.rawText: After this Kimie met Kaede-sama. She taught me everything she knew.
units.displayText: After this Kimie met Kaede-sama. She taught me everything she knew.

spans.text: After this Kimie met Kaede-sama. She taught me everything she knew.

units.rawText: In spring, we enjoy the flowers; in autumn we tread on dried branches. The seasons come and go, over and over again. There will always be things that sink and vanish into the long river of time, as there will also be things that splash in the water, unwilling to disappear.
units.displayText: In spring, we enjoy the flowers; in autumn we tread on dried branches. The seasons come and go, over and over again. There will always be things that sink and vanish into the long river of time, as there will also be things that splash in the water, unwilling to disappear.

units.rawText: A Doll who venerates the kami has appeared; is that not because of this unwillingness?
units.displayText: A Doll who venerates the kami has appeared; is that not because of this unwillingness?

spans.text: A Doll who venerates the kami has appeared; is that not because of this unwillingness?

units.rawText: This Kimie is foolish and cannot apprehend your meaning, Kaede-sama.
units.displayText: This Kimie is foolish and cannot apprehend your meaning, Kaede-sama.

spans.text: This Kimie is foolish and cannot apprehend your meaning, Kaede-sama.

units.rawText: Come with me, and see. See what people believe in, what they pray for, and why they seek the kami.
units.displayText: Come with me, and see. See what people believe in, what they pray for, and why they seek the kami.

spans.text: Come with me, and see. See what people believe in, what they pray for, and why they seek the kami.

units.rawText: I traveled with Kaede-sama for three years. Those three years took me through humble villages and grand temples alike.
units.displayText: I traveled with Kaede-sama for three years. Those three years took me through humble villages and grand temples alike.

spans.text: I traveled with Kaede-sama for three years. Those three years took me through humble villages and grand temples alike.

units.rawText: At first, people did not know I was a Doll until it so happened that the shrine opened its Akimatsuri to visitors.
units.displayText: At first, people did not know I was a Doll until it so happened that the shrine opened its Akimatsuri to visitors.

spans.text: At first, people did not know I was a Doll until it so happened that the shrine opened its Akimatsuri to visitors.

units.rawText: Some children were playing with fireworks, which ignited the shimenawa connected to the prayer bell. The wooden shrine soon caught fire.
units.displayText: Some children were playing with fireworks, which ignited the shimenawa connected to the prayer bell. The wooden shrine soon caught fire.

spans.text: Some children were playing with fireworks, which ignited the shimenawa connected to the prayer bell. The wooden shrine soon caught fire.

units.rawText: When I went to rescue those children, my body was damaged by a falling support beam. I lost an arm and a leg but still managed to rescue them.
units.displayText: When I went to rescue those children, my body was damaged by a falling support beam. I lost an arm and a leg but still managed to rescue them.

spans.text: When I went to rescue those children, my body was damaged by a falling support beam. I lost an arm and a leg but still managed to rescue them.

units.rawText: I returned from the fire, without bleeding, and without pain. However, my bare circuits told everyone that this Kimie was a Doll. And then, the nightmare began...
